Dikembe Mutombo

Pronunciation: \dih-KEHM-bay moo-TAHM-boh\

Dikembe Mutombo

(Full name Dikembe Mutombo Mpolondo Mukamba Jean-Jacques Wamutombo)

(Deke, Mt. Mutombo)

Position: Center ▪ Shoots: Right

7-2, 245lb (218cm, 111kg)

Born: June 25, 1966 in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo cd

Died: September 30, 2024

Relatives: Nephew Mfiondu Kabengele

College: Georgetown

High School: Institute Boboto in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo

Draft: Denver Nuggets, 1st round (4th pick, 4th overall), 1991 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: November 1, 1991

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2015 (Full List)

Career Length: 18 years

Frequently Asked Questions

Where was Dikembe Mutombo born?

Dikembe Mutombo was born in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

When was Dikembe Mutombo born?

Dikembe Mutombo was born on June 25, 1966.

How tall was Dikembe Mutombo?

Dikembe Mutombo was 7-2 (218 cm) tall.

How much did Dikembe Mutombo weigh when playing?

Dikembe Mutombo weighed 245 lbs (111 kg) when playing.

Is Dikembe Mutombo in the Hall of Fame?

Dikembe Mutombo was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2015 (Full List) .

When was Dikembe Mutombo drafted?

Dikembe Mutombo was drafted by Denver Nuggets, 1st round (4th pick, 4th overall), 1991 NBA Draft.

What position did Dikembe Mutombo play?

Center.

When did Dikembe Mutombo retire?

Dikembe Mutombo last played in 2009.

What did Dikembe Mutombo average?

Dikembe Mutombo averaged 9.8 points, 10.3 rebounds, and 1.0 assists per game.

How many rings does Dikembe Mutombo have?

Dikembe Mutombo won 0 championships.

What schools did Dikembe Mutombo attend?

Dikembe Mutombo attended Institute Boboto in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo and Georgetown.

What are Dikembe Mutombo's nicknames?

Deke, Mt. Mutombo are nicknames for Dikembe Mutombo.
